title: EntityFrame
responsibility: Finds the entity an address names, heads its screen with it, and says that the entity is missing where the revision does not hold it.

inputs.name: EntityFrame.host
inputs.description: Everything the host gives a screen: the shown revision, address, entities and its answers.

inputs.name: EntityFrame.children
inputs.description: The screen of the entity the address names; it is given that entity.

outputs.name: EntityFrame.entityHeaderAndScreen
outputs.description: The header of the entity, then its screen.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.
